column7: serveAuthCacheHit's session branch only re-checked the owning account's state, never whether the session row itself still existed -- RevokeUserSessions and 6 sibling call sites (ChangePassword, ActivateMFA/DisableMFA, WebAuthn enrollment/removal, both setup-token-consume paths, the /system proxy's DeleteSessionsForUserExcept) could leave a deleted session authenticating via a stale positive cache entry; fixed by core.SessionLiveForToken wired into serveAuthCacheHit; found by FuzzConcurrentOpsLinearizable, landed same PR; see docs/findings/2026-09-20-FINDING-session-revoke-cache-race.md
